## cpp-peglib

- **File**: `peglib.h`
- **Version**: 1.17.0
- **Source**: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-peglib
- **Licence**: MIT
- **Purpose**: Header-only PEG (Parsing Expression Grammar) parser library used
  to drive the C23 preprocessing-token lexer (translation phase 3).
